== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Modern [[Imperial Entanglements / No One To Stop Us This Time]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published text state; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous column; a change of the printed errata mark alone is its own column. Cells give the printed card text (▼ is the printed deploy-from-Reserve-Deck notation). A sentence that moved is highlighted where it now stands. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
